assessments.intent_alignment: Red -> Green -> Refactor and independent task code review are nested within task execution; all valid local findings require completion, broader behavior-preserving proposals are parked with refactoring tag, and necessary contract redesign uses Spec Change.
assessments.scope_and_retries: Existing candidate review, verification, ownership, FF integration and bounded retry semantics remain; no unnecessary runner states or CLI return changes are planned.
assessments.parking: Complete attributed tagged drafts and pending publication status persist in runtime review evidence until all candidates integrate and no writer or resumable candidate remains. Terminal coordinator materialization preserves task FF eligibility and interruption recovery.
assessments.test_classification: RF-005/006/007 have public CLI integration obligations. PREP-01/02/04 require behavior Red/Green; PREP-03/05/06 and LOOP-01..05 are unchanged behavior regressions requiring current execution. BUNDLE-01/02 test changed installation/upgrade delivery.
assessments.failure_coverage: Explicit cases cover rejected/stale review, approved candidate failed checks, retry bounds, nonzero required installation with stale files, zero-exit missing required primary output, optional missing output and validation-only nonmutation.
assessments.task_graph: RF-01 -> RF-02 -> RF-03 is serial; exact graph and test scopes agree. Every executable case has its planned task owner; RF-01 has independent semantic-review obligations.
assessments.bundles: Canonical lifecycle rules are referenced by stages and all runtime projections. Preparation override is idempotent, preserves upstream pins and unrelated content, and is verified in both prepared skill views. Install/upgrade checks preserve consumer overlays.
assessments.planning_stop: Approval covers the reviewed Plan only. No implementation, behavior tests, task initialization, merge, push, or implementation completion is authorized or claimed.
